# UnaDomot — Component Visual Specification

**Inputs received.** I received the existing source-grounded HANDOFF (`UnaDomot_UI_UX_Specification.md`, whose actual section structure differs from the requested alias `screenshot_pixel_to_pixel.md`) and all three DUMPS: 182 `FILE:` entries across `ui_dump_1/2/3.txt` (35,911 extracted source lines). The closure plan is G1 per-component/page visual and state detail, G2 every recoverable inline SVG path, G3 exact source-string deck, G4 literal conditional-state deltas with explicit unknowns, G5 keyframes/transitions, G6 boot/splash source, and G7 Flutter mappings. The HANDOFF remains authoritative; citations below use its actual §5 component and §6 page structure.

## 1. Scope and how to use this document

This is the companion to the HANDOFF: it supplies source-extracted component/page visual structure, class inventories, states, copy candidates, icon paths, and motion evidence; the HANDOFF remains authoritative for product scope, global tokens, themes, routing, architecture, and file inventory. Evidence grammar: **Literal** = directly present in source; **Derived** = direct consequence of multiple literal statements; **Not specified** = no reliable exact source value (any suggested implementation is explicitly `[PROPOSED DEFAULT]`); **Conflict / defect** = contradictory or incomplete evidence. The source is React 18 `React.createElement`, not JSX. Because class expressions, helper functions, CSS selectors, and conditional render branches can be spread across files, each subsection preserves literal expressions and marks what cannot be safely collapsed into one rendered state.

## 2. Resolved-value legend

| Utility | Resolved CSS | Theme / responsive override |
|---|---|---|
| `bg-green-950` | background-color: #052e16 | light: #052e16; dark theme override is defined in styles/themes/dark.css for green background utilities; high-contrast overrides globally |
| `text-gray-900` | color: #111827 | light exact mapping; dark.css maps gray-900 text to #f1f5f9 |
| `text-gray-700` | color: #374151 | light exact mapping; dark.css maps gray-700 text to #f1f5f9 |
| `text-gray-500` | color: #6b7280 | dark.css maps gray-500 to #cbd5e1 |
| `text-gray-400` | color: #9ca3af | dark.css maps gray-400 to #9ca3af |
| `border-gray-200` | border-color: #e5e7eb | dark.css maps gray borders to #334155 |
| `border-gray-300` | border-color: #d1d5db | dark.css maps gray borders to #334155 |
| `rounded-lg` | border-radius: 0.5rem (8px) | unless a more specific component CSS rule overrides |
| `rounded-xl` | border-radius: 0.75rem (12px) | unless a more specific component CSS rule overrides |
| `rounded-2xl` | border-radius: 1rem (16px) | unless a more specific component CSS rule overrides |
| `rounded-full` | border-radius: 9999px | unless a more specific component CSS rule overrides |
| `shadow-sm` | box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05) | Tailwind default unless theme/component selector overrides |
| `shadow-md` | box-shadow: 0 4px 6px -1px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1), 0 2px 4px -2px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1) | Tailwind default unless theme/component selector overrides |
| `shadow-lg` | box-shadow: 0 10px 15px -3px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1), 0 4px 6px -4px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1) | Tailwind default unless theme/component selector overrides |
| `shadow-2xl` | box-shadow: 0 25px 50px -12px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.25) | Tailwind default unless theme/component selector overrides |
| `text-xs` | font-size: 0.75rem (12px); line-height: 1rem | mobile.css sets .text-xs to 10px at max-width 640px |
| `text-sm` | font-size: 0.875rem (14px); line-height: 1.25rem | theme files may alter color only, not default size |
| `text-base` | font-size: 1rem (16px); line-height: 1.5rem | theme files may alter color only, not default size |
| `text-lg` | font-size: 1.125rem (18px); line-height: 1.75rem | theme files may alter color only, not default size |
| `text-2xl` | font-size: 1.5rem (24px); line-height: 2rem | theme files may alter color only, not default size |
| `p-1…p-12` | padding: 4px increments per Tailwind spacing scale (1=4px, 12=48px) | global theme overrides do not change spacing |
| `gap-1…gap-12` | gap: 4px increments per Tailwind spacing scale (1=4px, 12=48px) | global theme overrides do not change spacing |
| `w-3…w-14` | width: 12px…56px in 4px increments | global theme overrides do not change dimensions |

Spacing note: Tailwind's default spacing scale is 4px × utility number (`p-1` = 4px, `p-2` = 8px, …, `p-12` = 48px; same scale for `gap-*`). Width utilities `w-3` through `w-14` resolve to 12px through 56px in 4px increments. The actual Tailwind CDN version is controlled by the shell; HANDOFF §1.2 is authoritative for runtime loading.

### Multi-colour Google “G” icon — four literal sub-paths

The Google sign-in/sign-up icon appears in both `components/LoginForm.js` and `components/SignupForm.js`; each SVG has `viewBox="0 0 24 24"`, class `w-5 h-5`, and four separately filled path elements. There is no global `fill` or `stroke` on the SVG; each path owns its fill.

| Sub-path | Fill | Exact `d` |
|---|---|---|

| 2 | `#34A853` | `M12 23c2.97 0 5.46-.98 7.28-2.66l-3.57-2.77c-.98.66-2.23 1.06-3.71 1.06-2.86 0-5.29-1.93-6.16-4.53H2.18v2.84C3.99 20.53 7.7 23 12 23z` |

**Usage difference:** Login button copy is `Continue with Google`; Signup button copy is `Sign up with Google`. The surrounding buttons have distinct padding (`py-3` for login; `py-2.5` for signup) but both enforce `minHeight: '44px'`.

```css
@keyframes shake {

      }
```

### Exact inline splash CSS (Literal — `index.html`)

```css
#root {
    min-height: 100vh;
    opacity: 0;
    transition: opacity 0.3s ease-in;
}

#root.ready {
    opacity: 1;
}

.splash-screen {
    position: fixed;
    top: 0;
    left: 0;
    right: 0;
    bottom: 0;
    background: #f0fdf4;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    z-index: 9999;
    transition: opacity 0.3s ease-out;
}

.splash-screen.hidden {
    opacity: 0;
    pointer-events: none;
}

.splash-center {
    flex: 1;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
}

.splash-logo {
    width: 100px;
    height: 100px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    object-fit: cover;
    animation: pulse 3s infinite;
}

@keyframes pulse {
    0%, 100% { transform: scale(0.8); }
    50% { transform: scale(1.2); }
}
```

- Splash image element: `<img src="/vault/img/unadomot.jpg" alt="UnaDomot" class="splash-logo">` inside `.splash-center`, itself inside `.splash-screen`.
- `.splash-logo`: 100×100 CSS px; circle crop (`border-radius:50%`); `object-fit:cover`; `pulse 3s infinite`; pulse scales 0.8 → 1.2 → 0.8.
- `#root`: initial opacity 0; `.ready` opacity 1; transition `opacity 0.3s ease-in`.
- `.splash-screen`: fixed full viewport; `z-index:9999`; background `#f0fdf4`; fade-out transition `opacity 0.3s ease-out`; `.hidden` sets opacity 0 and disables pointer events.

### `hideSplashScreen()` teardown (Literal — `index.html`)

```javascript
window.hideSplashScreen = function() {
    const splash = document.querySelector('.splash-screen');
    const root = document.getElementById('root');

    if (splash) {
        splash.classList.add('hidden');
    }

    if (root) {
        root.classList.add('ready');
    }

    setTimeout(() => {
        if (splash) {
            splash.remove();
        }
    }, 300);
};
```

`App` invokes `window.hideSplashScreen()` after the app's initial loading state resolves, with a 100ms timeout at its call site. The 300ms teardown is the splash removal delay, not the fade-in duration. [SOURCE] Dark-mode preboot script reads `localStorage.getItem('darkMode') === 'true'` and adds `dark-mode` to `document.body` before app rendering; see HANDOFF §3.1 and source `index.html`.

**Flutter mapping:** render splash with a full-screen `Stack`, centered `ClipOval` + `Image.asset(fit: BoxFit.cover)` at the source-resolved size, and a pulse animation driven by `AnimationController`/`Tween`. Fade the root content using `AnimatedOpacity`. Delay teardown by the source's 300ms before removing the splash. [PROPOSED DEFAULT] use `SystemChrome`/theme initialization before first frame to avoid a theme flash; preserve the source's dark-mode pre-boot localStorage behavior rather than assuming Flutter storage semantics.

```javascript
        } else {
```

```javascript
        }
      },
      className: 'fixed bottom-24 right-4 bg-green-950 text-white rounded-full p-3 shadow-lg hover:bg-green-800 transition-all duration-300 transform hover:scale-110',

        display: 'block',

    },

        fill: 'none',
        stroke: 'currentColor',
        viewBox: '0 0 24 24'
      },

        strokeLinejoin: 'round',
        strokeWidth: '2',

      })
    )

}
```

```javascript
      openModal('login', window.location.pathname);
      return;

        currentUserId,
        listing.id,

          if (!success) {
            setIsFavorite(previousState);
          }
        }
      );
      
      setIsFavorite(newStatus);
      
      if (window.AppCache) {
        AppCache.set('favorites', `${currentUserId}_${listing.id}`, newStatus);
      }
      
      if (onFavoriteToggle) {
        onFavoriteToggle(listing.id, newStatus);
      }
      
      showToastMessage(
        newStatus ? '✓ Saved to favorites' : '✓ Removed from favorites'
      );
      
    } catch (error) {
      setIsFavorite(previousState);
      showToastMessage('Failed to save. Please try again.', true);
    } finally {
      setCheckingFavorite(false);
    }
  };
```

```javascript
    return () => {
      document.body.classList.remove('chat-open', 'hide-bottom-nav', 'chat-interface-active');
    };
  }, []);
  
  // ===== SCROLL TO BOTTOM =====
  const scrollToBottom = React.useCallback((force = false) => {
    if (messagesEndRef.current) {
      setTimeout(() => {
        messagesEndRef.current.scrollIntoView({ 
          behavior: force ? 'smooth' : 'auto',
          block: 'nearest'
        });
      }, 100);
    }
  }, []);
  
  React.useEffect(() => {
    scrollToBottom(true);
  }, [messages, scrollToBottom]);
  
  // ===== VALIDATE CHAT =====
  React.useEffect(function() {
    if (!chatId || !currentUserId) return;
    
    const validateAccess = async function() {
      try {
        const result = await ChatHelpers.validateChatAccess(chatId, currentUserId);
        if (!result.valid) {
          // Error handled by hook
        } else {
          setChatValidated(true);
          setChatData(result.chatData);
          
          if (result.chatData.listingId) {
            const listing = await ChatHelpers.getChatListingInfo(chatId);
            setListingInfo(listing);
          }
        }
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('Validation error:', error);
      }
    };
    
    validateAccess();
  }, [chatId, currentUserId]);
  
  // ===== FETCH OTHER USER (INCLUDING USERNAME) =====
  React.useEffect(function() {
    if (!otherUserId) return;
    
    if (otherUserName) {
      setOtherUserData({
        name: otherUserName,
        photoURL: otherUserPhoto || null,
        username: null
      });
      return;
    }
    
    const fetchOtherUser = async function() {
      try {
        const userDoc = await db.collection('users').doc(otherUserId).get();
        if (userDoc.exists) {
          const data = userDoc.data();
          setOtherUserData({
            name: data.displayName || data.name || 'User',
            photoURL: data.photoURL || null,
            username: data.username || null  // ===== GET USERNAME =====
          });
        }
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('Error fetching other user:', error);
      }
    };
    
    fetchOtherUser();
  }, [otherUserId, otherUserName, otherUserPhoto]);
  
  // ===== TYPING INDICATOR =====
  React.useEffect(function() {
    if (!chatId || !chatValidated || !currentUserId) return;
    
    const typingRef = db.collection('chats').doc(chatId)
      .collection('typing').doc('status');
    
    typingListenerRef.current = typingRef.onSnapshot(function(doc) {
      if (doc.exists) {
        const data = doc.data();
        if (data.userId && data.userId !== currentUserId && data.isTyping) {
          const isRecent = Date.now() - (data.timestamp?.toMillis?.() || 0) < 3000;
          setOtherUserTyping(isRecent);
        } else {
          setOtherUserTyping(false);
        }
      } else {
        setOtherUserTyping(false);
      }
    });
    
```

```javascript
    return () => {
      if (currentMain) {
        currentMain.removeEventListener('scroll', handleScroll);
      }
      saveScrollPosition();
    };
  }, [currentPath]);
  
  // ===== RESTORE SCROLL POSITION =====
  React.useEffect(() => {
    if (mainRef.current) {
      try {
        const saved = sessionStorage.getItem(`scroll_${currentPath}`);
        if (saved) {
          const position = parseInt(saved, 10);
          if (!isNaN(position)) {
            setTimeout(() => {
              if (mainRef.current) {
                mainRef.current.scrollTop = position;
              }
            }, 50);
          }
        }
      } catch (e) {}
    }
  }, [currentPath]);
  
  // ===== DESKTOP LAYOUT =====

      // Left Navigation
      React.createElement('nav', {
          className: 'desktop-nav'
        },
        React.createElement('div', null,
          navItems.map(item => {
            const isActive = currentPath === item.path;
            
            return React.createElement('div', {
                key: item.path,
                onClick: () => handleNavClick(item.path, item.protected, item.isPost),
                className: `desktop-nav-item ${isActive ? 'active' : ''}`
              },
              item.icon,
              React.createElement('span', null, item.label)
            );
          })
        )
      ),
      
      // Right Content Area
      React.createElement('div', {
          className: 'flex-1 flex flex-col overflow-hidden'
        },
        
        // ===== TOP BAR (only on homepage grid view) =====
        isHomePage && viewMode === 'grid' && React.createElement(Header, {
          user: user,
          navigate: navigate,
          installProps: installProps,
          isDesktop: true,
          currentPath: currentPath,
          isHomePage: true,
          viewMode: viewMode,
          onViewToggle: window.__homePageState?.handleViewToggle
        }),
        
        // ===== BACK BUTTON PANEL - CONDITIONALLY RENDERED =====
        !isHomePage && !hasChatOpen && React.createElement('div', {
            className: 'desktop-back-panel'
          },
          React.createElement('div', {
              onClick: () => window.history.back(),
```

```javascript
    return () => document.removeEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
  }, []);

  const searchLocation = async (text) => {
    if (text.length < 3) {
      setResults([]);
      return;
    }

    setSearching(true);
    
    try {
      // Use Nominatim for location search
      const response = await fetch(
        `https://nominatim.openstreetmap.org/search?format=json&q=${encodeURIComponent(text + ', Nigeria')}&limit=5`,
        { headers: { 'User-Agent': 'UnaDomot/1.0' } }
      );
      const data = await response.json();
      setResults(data);
      setShowResults(true);
    } catch (error) {
      
    } finally {
      setSearching(false);
    }
  };

  const debouncedSearch = React.useCallback(
    debounce(searchLocation, 500), []
  );

  const handleInputChange = (e) => {
    const value = e.target.value;
    setQuery(value);
    debouncedSearch(value);
  };

  const handleSelect = (result) => {
    setQuery(result.display_name.split(',')[0]);
    setShowResults(false);
    onLocationSelect({
      lat: parseFloat(result.lat),
      lng: parseFloat(result.lon),
      name: result.display_name
    });
  };

  return React.createElement('div', {
    ref: searchRef,
    className: 'relative flex-1'
  },
    React.createElement('input', {
      type: 'text',
      value: query,
      onChange: handleInputChange,
      placeholder: 'Search location...',
      className: 'w-full pl-9 pr-8 py-2 border border-gray-300 rounded-full text-sm focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-green-950'
    }),
    React.createElement('svg', {
      className: 'absolute left-3 top-2.5 w-4 h-4 text-gray-400',
      fill: 'none',
      stroke: 'currentColor',
      viewBox: '0 0 24 24'
    },
      React.createElement('path', {
        strokeLinecap: 'round',
        strokeLinejoin: 'round',
        strokeWidth: '2',
        d: 'M21 21l-6-6m2-5a7 7 0 11-14 0 7 7 0 0114 0z'
      })
    ),
    searching && React.createElement('div', {
      className: 'absolute right-3 top-2.5 w-4 h-4 border-2 border-green-950 border-t-transparent rounded-full animate-spin'
    }),

    showResults && results.length > 0 && React.createElement('div', {
      className: 'absolute top-full left-0 right-0 mt-1 bg-white rounded-lg shadow-xl border border-gray-200 z-50 max-h-60 overflow-y-auto'
    },
      results.map((r, i) => 
        React.createElement('button', {
          key: i,
          onClick: () => handleSelect(r),
          className: 'w-full text-left px-4 py-2 hover:bg-green-50 text-sm border-b last:border-0'
        }, r.display_name)
      )
    )
  );
}

// Debounce helper
function debounce(func, wait) {
  let timeout;
  return function executedFunction(...args) {
    const later = () => {
      clearTimeout(timeout);
      func(...args);
    };
    clearTimeout(timeout);
    timeout = setTimeout(later, wait);
  };
```

```javascript
    return () => document.removeEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);

  const searchLocation = async (text) => {
    if (text.length < 3) {
      setResults([]);
      return;
    }

    setSearching(true);
    
    try {
      // Use Nominatim for location search
      const response = await fetch(
        `https://nominatim.openstreetmap.org/search?format=json&q=${encodeURIComponent(text + ', Nigeria')}&limit=5`,
        { headers: { 'User-Agent': 'UnaDomot/1.0' } }
      );
      const data = await response.json();
      setResults(data);
      setShowResults(true);
    } catch (error) {
      
    } finally {
      setSearching(false);
    }
  };

  const debouncedSearch = React.useCallback(
    debounce(searchLocation, 500), []
  );

  const handleInputChange = (e) => {
    const value = e.target.value;
    setQuery(value);
    debouncedSearch(value);
  };

  const handleSelect = (result) => {
    setQuery(result.display_name.split(',')[0]);
    setShowResults(false);
    onLocationSelect({
      lat: parseFloat(result.lat),
      lng: parseFloat(result.lon),
      name: result.display_name
    });
  };

  return React.createElement('div', {
    ref: searchRef,
    className: 'relative flex-1'
  },

    searching && React.createElement('div', {

    }),

    showResults && results.length > 0 && React.createElement('div', {

    },

        }, r.display_name)
      )
    )
  );
}

// Debounce helper
function debounce(func, wait) {
  let timeout;
  return function executedFunction(...args) {
    const later = () => {
      clearTimeout(timeout);
      func(...args);
    };
    clearTimeout(timeout);
    timeout = setTimeout(later, wait);
  };
```

  };

```javascript
    className: `fixed ${positions[position]} z-50 max-w-md w-full transform transition-all duration-300 ${

    }`

              userMessage.message

            userMessage.suggestion &&

                '💡 ' + userMessage.suggestion
              )
          ),

            onClick: () => {
              setIsVisible(false);
              setTimeout(onClose, 300);
            },

          },
            React.createElement('svg', { className: 'w-4 h-4', fill: 'none', stroke: 'currentColor', viewBox: '0 0 24 24' },
              React.createElement('path', { strokeLinecap: 'round', strokeLinejoin: 'round', strokeWidth: '2', d: 'M6 18L18 6M6 6l12 12' })

}
```

| `Service worker / offline cache` | `connectivity_plus` for connectivity state plus cached image provider/local persistence; offline cache policy must match source service-worker cache list. | Source-specific values in §6–§7; global baseline HANDOFF §12.2. |
| ``localStorage` accessibility/theme` | `SharedPreferences` with exact source keys and startup hydration before first frame. | Source-specific values in §6–§7; global baseline HANDOFF §12.2. |
| `Focus ring utilities` | `FocusableActionDetector` / `Focus` and explicit `BoxDecoration` ring; preserve keyboard-visible focus. | Source-specific values in §6–§7; global baseline HANDOFF §12.2. |

| ``min-h-screen` / viewport overlays` | `MediaQuery.sizeOf(context).height` + `SafeArea` where source safe-area behavior exists; do not add safe-area padding if it changes fixed bars. | Source-specific values in §6–§7; global baseline HANDOFF §12.2. |

This is an explicit evidence boundary, not a claim that every possible runtime state has been screenshot-verified.
